Question B-002-005-011.

Why the correct answer is right: In Morse, R means all received.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "End of message": End of message is a separate procedural signal, not R.
- sourceIndex 2: "Called station only reply": Called-station-only reply is not the meaning assigned to R.
- sourceIndex 3: "Repeat all": Repeat all asks for retransmission; R says the material was copied.
